Hoang’s Kitchen Nice selection
Oct 2026 • Couples
Me and my girlfriend found this place online looking for a restaurant that would accommodate vegan and pescatarian diets. They had a nice selection for me since I am vegan which is nice, I had the curry, fried seafood mushrooms and vegetable dumplings. I liked the fried mushrooms, they reminded me of old school fish sticks from back in the day as a kid a little lol. My girlfriend had the traditional fried catfish, mango salad, and mango strawberry juice. She said the catfish was delicious and the mango juice was really good. The staff was very nice and helpful as well, the atmosphere was chill and quiet.

Brilliant service, great food, and a wonderful host
Oct 2026 • Family
We had an absolutely brilliant experience here. The food was excellent from start to finish: fresh, full of flavour and beautifully presented.

What really set the evening apart was the service, and Tini in particular. She was a fantastic host who made sure each and every one of us was looked after. Nothing was too much trouble, and her warmth and attentiveness made us feel genuinely welcome.

Great food, great service and a lovely atmosphere. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting, and we'll certainly be back.
